purpose: 用独立保留的检查点正常复核序号 2，展示原决策、历史策略重算结果和一致性。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 3 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 同一早期目标遇到后续理由声明 4294967295 字节，观察完整归档读取失败及真实错误输出。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive ledger-damaged.audit --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 3 --fingerprint "$(cat ledger.fingerprint)"
output:
review: archive validation failed: darksafe: invalid audit archive: truncated archive payload
exit status 1
